PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); the package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached or run, no network or pip was used, and the read-only clone was not modified. WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0] g1_description/scene.xml, which includes g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml, as a simulated R0 MujocoDriver. The loaded model is 36 qpos, 35 qvel and 29 motor actuators, with a 0.002 s timestep and a free base at the pelvis pose (0 0 0.793); cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [29]}}, cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults, and the state is the bridge integration state. The card's models[1] g1_29dof_LieDown.xml and models[2] g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml are not served as separate devices: one package serves one device, and scene.xml already includes models[2]. NO CONTROL LIMIT: the 29 motors declare no ctrlrange (g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml:247-277), so the bridge derives no actuator_ctrlrange and the driver declares no control limit; the upstream deploy_mujoco application clips tau to tau_limit (deploy_mujoco/config/mujoco.yaml:5-9, deploy_mujoco/deploy_mujoco.py:86-87), but that is a clamp of the joystick/policy loop, not a bound of the MJCF model, so it is not presented as a device limit. No bound was invented or copied from a catalogue default; no site-limits.example.json is needed. FAKE: MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs, so backends['fake'] is fake.py, a stand-in mujoco module. It parses the scene and its include for the joint and actuator counts, the free-base start pose and the 2 ms timestep, but integrates a placeholder torque response and resolves no mesh, texture, contact, constraint, gravity, inertia or sensor; it was not compared with MuJoCo and the sim path (a backend name backends does not list) was not run. The fidelity contract is F1, exact determinism, 2 ms lockstep, full reset, snapshot_restore true; its gaps list the differences and that the upstream loop uses simulation_dt 0.003 s and runs the FSM every 7 steps. EXPECTED WARNINGS, all explained: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is a stand-in library object, not the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no limit on any actuating capability, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe); and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed). G4 passed with no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings, and G9 passed. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. No deviation from the card: the family-config/MujocoDriver decision expresses the model files; the card lists no entry_symbols, and the model files were confirmed in the clone. check-report.json is [...]
